player_prompt.intro:
We u Player {player_id} mwa {num_rounds}-round ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Kila round, kamba nambari kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Kufwa mawili kamba, chenje ni (2/3)x(wastani wa mawili kamba),
na Player uye kamba chenje ni pafupi sana na chenje uina ile round.
Yamuka na kamba yenu mu fomu '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomu ishikilwe; tafadhal kamba yenu mu fomu '[<number>]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Khanisa lazima iwe kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Muthusa 0 akhanisa {guess0}; Muthusa 1 akhanisa {guess1}. Kwa hiyo Thageti ni: {target}.
